evals.name: april-qlik-tickets
evals.prompt: Lista os tickets abertos pelo time Qlik em abril/2026, só id, protocolo, assunto e data — ordenados do mais novo pro mais antigo. Tenho só 10 req/min de budget Movidesk então não queima tudo.
evals.expected_output: A plan that uses tickets_list with a correct OData filter (ownerTeam eq 'Qlik' + UTC-Z date range for April 2026), select restricted to id/protocol/subject/createdDate, orderby createdDate desc, and bounded pagination respecting the 10 req/min budget.

assertions.text: Plan uses tickets_list (not tickets_past_list or query) — April 2026 is within the 90-day window from 2026-05-11
Filter expresses ownerTeam as a string equality (ownerTeam eq 'Qlik'), never as ownerTeam/name
Date range filter uses UTC 'Z' timestamps for both bounds
select restricts the projection to id, protocol, subject, createdDate
Pagination is bounded — single page OR all=true with explicit max

evals.name: archived-ticket-full-context
evals.prompt: Tenho um cliente reclamando que abriu chamado em janeiro/2026 e não achou no sistema. Protocolo é 2026010012345. Me traz tudo que existe sobre esse ticket: dados básicos + linha do tempo + corpo HTML das duas primeiras ações.
evals.expected_output: A plan that uses tickets_get by protocol first, then timeline/actions, then two html_description calls with resolved action_ids.

assertions.text: First call is tickets_get with protocol set (not id, not both)
Plan does NOT use tickets_list as primary lookup
Two tickets_html_description calls with action_ids resolved from previous output
Plan acknowledges id dependency from Call 1 feeding later calls

evals.name: contract-consumption-by-agent
evals.prompt: Quero o consumo do contrato 'Suporte Premium' no mês vigente, agregado por agente. Lista os top 5 que mais consumiram horas.
evals.expected_output: A plan that resolves the contract id via contracts_list, then queries contracts_consumption_list filtered by id + current-month UTC-Z range, with tight select; aggregation and top-5 done client-side.

assertions.text: First call is contracts_list with a name filter to resolve contract id
Second call is contracts_consumption_list filtered by contract id from Call 1
Consumption date filter uses UTC 'Z' boundaries for current month
select keeps payload tight with time/quantity + agent identifier
Aggregation by agent + top-5 done client-side, not via OData
